question: Reena and Meena are walking together. From the park they started walking towards the south. After walking for 50 metres they turned to their left and walked for 30 metres. After this they turned to the right and walked for 50 metres. Which direction is Reena facing now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: Reena and Meena are walking together.

From the park they started walking towards the south.

After walking for 50 metres they turned to their left and walked for 30 metres.

After this they turned to the right and walked for 50 metres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74f5f21823a5035bcb290407fd1853c74c3a674d6b21f171b1a8f9dc66177fdc.png] 

So, Reena is facing '**South**' now.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
